sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the story quests, see story chapters.

Quests, both player-given and dynamically generated, are intended to be a large part of Escape from Tarkov.

Some require you to pick stuff up for certain traders, while others require you to kill other operators or mark vehicles and specific places.
Quests are the fastest way of gaining EXP. Completing one will often reward you with experience points, trader reputation, money, valuable loot, rare containers, and unlock the purchase of new items.

When a trader has a quest available, they will have a green tick on their icon.

sections.heading: Quest items
sections.text:
Some items only spawn if the respective quest is active. These items fall in the and cannot be used, sold or discarded.
- Quest items do not spawn in the practice game mode.
- When picked up, quest items are transferred to the player's quest item inventory. If the player fails to extract with a quest item, they will lose it.
To prevent losing quest items, it is strongly recommended to turn them in before starting another raid or transferring them to the quest item special stash in the "Quest items" tab of the "Tasks" tab if you do not want to continue the quest in the next raid (e.g. during Delivery From the Past).
- While quest items are required to be found in raid as there is no other way to obtain them, the player does not have to avoid the Run Through status.

sections.heading: Operational Tasks
sections.text: Operational tasks are random daily and weekly quests that are given to the player by various traders. They are typically simple quests, such as find and handover an item, or kill Scavs at a certain location. The rewards for these quests are largely randomized and can give a variety of items and EXP. If you do not want the task you have been given, you can pay the trader some roubles and take a reputation penalty for a new random task. Players who have bought the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game may replace 2 daily quests per day without penalty or fee.

sections.heading: Daily
sections.text: Daily operational tasks become available to players at level 5.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
The following is approximate data based on observation. Actual rewards vary over time for individual players based on their history of completing operational tasks.
| Character level | Reward |
| 5 - 45 | 3,782 - 10,532 EXP; Up to 364,000 Roubles or, if from Peacekeeper, up to 2,815 Euros; Up to 5 items |
| 46+ | 20,576 - 75,202 EXP; Up to 626,000 Roubles or, if from Peacekeeper, up to 6,400 Euros; Up to 8 items till level 70, no more items at level 71+ |
Operational tasks also provide +0.01 reputation with the respective trader.

sections.heading: Weekly
sections.text: Weekly operational tasks are also available to players at level 15. The tasks are a lot more difficult but the rewards are also vastly higher.
